title: Python attribute-write one-path read-side: #7 #13 #14 #1 #12 and the gated-MRO machinery (DEC-303 a86 item 2 fallback from GCLI-155)
description: Held task carved out of opum-ai/glyph-cli#238 (GCLI-155, 151b) by the DEC-303 (a86) item 2 fallback, which is pre-agreed and is a cut, not a patch. Round 2 at 2b3a2ba blocked on R1: a base name bound more than once at module scope, with a write to it, creates in-repo edges and drops POLY flags against origin/dev c733627. Shapes held here: #7 (a written class name in a base position), #13 (classSymbolOfName from-import reads), #14 (the class-attribute decorator arm and its own write-set collection), #1 (the module-scope gate in resolveBareName at 2649) and #12 (the star-resolution gate), plus all machinery that existed only for them: the gated mark on the merged C3 MRO, the gated checks in methodLookup/firstMethodEntry/instanceClassOf, the collectAttributeWrites all-gates-off bypass, and the decorator-side collectAttributeWrites call. | R1 EVIDENCE (measured on origin/dev c733627 and 2b3a2ba, fresh git-archive trees): same-module try/except double binding - dev 2 edges, bins 2/0/1/0, poly=2, k.m() refused; head 3 edges, bins 3/0/0/0, poly=0, with a CREATED call m.py:9:13 -> m.py:B.m and both surviving edges losing POLY. if/else double class B - dev 4 edges 4/0/2/0 poly=4; head 6 edges 6/0/0/0 poly=0, two CREATED k.m edges and four POLY drops. Star importer via `from m import *` - dev 2 edges 2/0/1/0 poly=2; head 3 edges 3/0/0/0 poly=0, one CREATED k.m edge. The attr-arm control (class D(m.B) in another file) is dev-equal on head. Without-write twins are dev-equal in all three. | R2-R5 (measured, non-blocking): R2 the __new__ constructorNote is lost on head (dev [{file app.py, line 5, reasons [__new__]}], head []); R3 the local construction inside a written module is REFUSED on head, a removal only, while x.m() and h() keep C.m; R4 an opaque bare base moves the external bin to the receiver bin; R5 no created edge in either C3 order (the two Inner.f calls are removed). | EXEMPTION ATTEMPT (measured in a scratch copy, not taken): exempting only the 2649 gate, via an optional parameter passed only from the multiply fallback in baseAlternatives, makes the same-module try/except and if/else variants byte-for-byte dev-equal but leaves the star-importer variant with its CREATED k.m edge, because that path does not reach the 2649 gate. The fallback is a cut, so this was not taken; it is recorded here as evidence if a later ruling wants the narrower fix. | CONSTRAINTS that bind this task: DEC-303 (a80) item 1 B1/B1b and (a86) item 1 - build the MRO write-blind as dev does, refuse at lookup when the path crosses a gated base, never fall through to the next base, and collect writes with all three gates off; removal-only, no created in-repo edge; two rounds of its own under DEC-161 and no third; the (a86) item 2 fallback terms apply again if a round blocks. GCLI-151b terms: every new shape gets a neighbour and receiver read fixture, the proof states its group count and fails rather than passes if it reads fewer groups, and removed edges are named in the PR. | The R1 fixtures are already in the #238 tree, rewritten to pin dev outcome; build on them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of #1, #7, #12, #13 and #14 names its opum-doc ruling or measurement ruling before it is built

Each built shape has a red-before green-after refused fixture with a resolving twin, the R1 three-variant fixtures (same-module try/except, if/else, star importer) are in the proof, and a mutant per path is observed red

Removal-only holds: the flag-extended subset check over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus shows no created and no flag-changed in-repo edge, with an observed-red control and a group floor; every removed edge is named in the PR

The gated-MRO machinery (mark on the merged C3, checks in methodLookup/firstMethodEntry/instanceClassOf, collectAttributeWrites bypass, decorator collection call) is restored only with the shapes that need it, and the R2-R5 outcomes are re-measured
No DEC-182 path class is touched and no dependency is added
